currency.basis: The artwork is from the official HYPE press kit distributed in 2024 (Commons upload 2024-11-27) and is the brand's current published logo.

identity.basis: The asset is the logo of HYPE S.p.A., the Banca Sella group payments fintech behind hype.it; identity disambiguated via official hype.it properties.

assessment.independenceRationale: The primary vector evidence is an independent Commons upload whose bytes match the officially named press-kit source; hype.it properties independently establish the entity identity.

variant.basis: Full-color mark variant: tri-color swirl with white letter counters (letters forming the mark, no separate wordmark text), viewBox 2000x1604.26, no accompanying bank-name text.

candidate.rationale: Original vector SVG (2497 bytes, byte-identical to the official presskit asset per Commons-registered SHA-1) of the current HYPE S.p.A. tri-color mark; replaces the accepted single-path blue design that matches no currently published HYPE artwork.

proposals.reason: The accepted icon is a single-path blue blob with white 'HYPE' lettering that matches no currently published HYPE artwork. The current official HYPE S.p.A. logo (Banca Sella group Italian payments fintech) is the tri-color coral/light-blue/blue swirl wordmark. The fetched asset is the original vector SVG from the official HYPE press kit (uploaded to Wikimedia Commons 2024-11-27; bytes match the Commons-registered SHA-1), an evidenced rebrand relative to the accepted design. The letters form part of the mark itself, satisfying standalone suitability.

sources.observation: Official HYPE property confirming the entity as the Banca Sella group Italian payments fintech; used for identity disambiguation against unrelated 'hype' brands.

sources.independenceGroup: Wikimedia Commons original upload of the official presskit asset
sources.observation: Wikimedia Commons original upload 'Logo banca HYPE S.p.A.' (2024-11-27) whose stated source is the official HYPE press kit (prstrgextfilewe01.blob.core.windows.net); file-page SHA-1 ca48f8661135f2ef43003eb8c4746dc7c689539f matches the fetched 2497-byte SVG. Tri-color swirl wordmark (coral #fc766a, light blue #3ccdff, blue #163cff, white counters).

Official HYPE press kit zip (upstream source named on the Commons file page); fetch attempt failed with an HTTPS transfer error (receipt evidence/15905/research-0d8e4953cfe741a5b13fb3b1c2070806/fetch-b2253508c60740daad9d51f54b824180), so the byte-identical Commons upload was used.
